articles.title: Clinical outcomes and quality of life after proton therapy for cranial and extracranial solitary fibrous tumors
articles.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of proton therapy for treating cranial and extracranial solitary fibrous tumors. Preliminary results indicate promising overall survival and local control rates, although late toxicities near the central nervous system warrant clinical vigilance.

articles.title: Design, implementation, and assessment of an independent second-check system for proton and carbon-ion pencil-beam scanning: delivery-aware Monte Carlo and microdosimetric RBE-weighted dose
articles.summary: Researchers have implemented a common platform to support independent physical and biological dose verification for ion therapy. The system utilizes delivery-aware Monte Carlo calculations and microdosimetric RBE-weighted assessment to improve treatment safety, though further validation is required before clinical deployment.

articles.title: Cone-beam CT-based synthetic CT generation for adaptive radiotherapy: methodological paradigms, clinical reliability assessment, and translation
articles.summary: This review evaluates deep learning methods used to generate synthetic CT images from cone-beam CT for adaptive radiotherapy. It focuses on the current state of image accuracy and the clinical reliability required for routine use in both photon and proton treatment workflows.

articles.title: Development of a phantom-based end-to-end QA workflow for online adaptive radiotherapy incorporating high-resolution 2D detector measurements
articles.summary: A new quality assurance workflow has been developed to verify adaptive dose calculations in real-time. By utilizing high-resolution 2D detectors, the method provides a reproducible and robust approach for assessing plan-specific deviations in adaptive clinical environments.

articles.title: Therapeutic Hybrid Intelligence with Neural and Knowledge-based Expert Reasoning for SRS (THINKERS): an AI model for melanoma brain metastases
articles.summary: This study introduces an AI-driven framework for patient-specific stereotactic radiosurgery dose comparison. The model demonstrated feasibility as an adjunct for evaluating radiosurgical plans in patients with melanoma brain metastases.

articles.title: Reliability-weighted patch learning for synthetic CT reconstruction in head and neck adaptive radiotherapy: A proof-of-concept study
articles.summary: This study explores the use of a reliability-weighted patch learning network (HQ-PatchNet) to improve synthetic CT quality from daily CBCT scans. The approach demonstrates potential for enhancing image quality in online adaptive radiotherapy workflows.

articles.title: Fully automated AI-based quantification of tumour volume on PSMA PET-CT images is associated with overall survival
articles.summary: This study investigates the prognostic value of fully automated AI-based tumor volume quantification from PSMA PET-CT imaging in prostate cancer. Results suggest that automated TLV correlates with overall survival, supporting its potential as a clinical biomarker.

articles.title: A Novel Medical Conformity Index (MCI) Integrating Spatial Distance and Target Volume Weighting for Enhanced Radiotherapy Plan Evaluation
articles.summary: Researchers developed a new Medical Conformity Index (MCI) that accounts for both geometric relationships and clinical dose weighting. This metric aims to provide a more comprehensive assessment of radiotherapy plan quality compared to traditional conformity indices.

articles.title: Comparative Analysis of Arc Geometrical Configurations and Jaw Tracking for Peripheral Low-Dose Bath in Whole Breast VMAT
articles.summary: This study compares how different arc geometries and jaw tracking techniques influence the peripheral low-dose bath during whole-breast volumetric modulated arc therapy. The research highlights strategies to minimize radiation exposure to organs at risk.

articles.title: BeamGAN: a physics-informed conditional generative adversarial network for Monte-Carlo-free portal dose image prediction from incident fluence maps
articles.summary: Researchers developed BeamGAN, a deep learning framework designed to predict portal dose images directly from incident fluence maps. This approach aims to enable real-time patient-specific quality assurance by bypassing time-intensive Monte Carlo simulations.

articles.title: Preoperative Contrast-Enhanced CT-Based Three-Dimensional Fractal Analysis of Automatically Segmented Tumors for Predicting PD-L1 Expression in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
articles.summary: This study explores the use of 3D fractal analysis on preoperative CT imaging to non-invasively predict PD-L1 expression in hepatocellular carcinoma. Such imaging biomarkers may help characterize tumor heterogeneity and guide immunotherapy decisions.

articles.title: Impact of extended field-of-view on image quality and stopping power ratio in proton therapy dose calculation
articles.summary: This research evaluates the dosimetric impact of using an extended field-of-view (eFOV) in CT simulation for proton therapy. The study analyzes how eFOV reconstruction affects Hounsfield unit-to-stopping power ratio curves and overall proton dose calculation accuracy.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer care. The findings emphasize the ongoing challenges in providing equitable radiation treatment coverage across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: ASTRO has released updated clinical guidelines recommending shorter-course radiation therapy for patients with localized prostate cancer. The update reflects evolving clinical standards aimed at optimizing patient outcomes and treatment efficiency.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has announced the treatment of the first patient in the C-FLASH-01 clinical trial, evaluating the safety and efficacy of ConformalFLASH proton therapy. This trial marks a significant milestone in testing ultra-high dose rate radiation delivery for head and neck cancer patients.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness facility dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers. This regional development enhances the supportive care infrastructure at this key proton therapy center in the DMV area.

articles.title: BayCare opens proton therapy center at Tampa's St. Joseph’s Hospital
articles.summary: BayCare has officially opened a new $33 million proton therapy facility at St. Joseph’s Hospital. The center aims to expand regional access to targeted radiation oncology services for cancer patients.

articles.title: Medicare change could cost standalone proton therapy centers millions
articles.summary: Proposed Medicare pricing changes threaten the financial viability of freestanding proton therapy centers, with potential revenue losses of nearly 30% by 2027. Advocacy groups warn this could limit patient access to highly precise radiation treatment.
